item.title: In 2005, this Australian home sold for A$420,000; 20 years later, it fetched A$1.375 million
item.description: Wonga Park in Australia has witnessed remarkable appreciation in property value, rising from A$420,000 in 2005 to A$1.375 million by 2025. This enchanting home boasts a 160-metre miniature railway, picturesque gardens, a chicken coop, and stunning vistas of the Dandenong Ranges. Its allure is further enhanced by five bedrooms and unique features, ensuring it remains a sought-after gem among buyers over the years. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
